S01.observed: Rightward truck along the glass edge: edge drifts left (~4% over 5 s), blurred background shifts less, no zoom
S01.caption: The edge of the glass, catching the light.

S02.observed: Rightward truck beside the pane: near mullion moves left, reflected tree holds its size, glass rigid
S02.caption: Along the pane, sky and a single tree held in the glass.

S03.observed: Camera slides down the mullion; transom rises on screen; mullion width constant; far lobby nearly still
S03.caption: Down the mullion, past a square, sealed joint.

S04.observed: Low forward push toward the threshold (~6% growth over 5 s) with near terrazzo moving faster; sill and light band steady
S04.caption: Toward the threshold, in a hard diagonal of afternoon light.

S05.observed: Locked camera (0 px). Closed right leaf begins to open on its right-jamb hinges; free edge with pull comes toward camera; pull attached, left leaf still. Owner-approved closed start
S05.caption: A door opens on its hinges.

S06.observed: Short level push into the open doorway: near jambs and leaves expand outward with depth, lobby stays put; leaves move only with the camera
S06.caption: Through the clear opening.

S07.observed: Restrained rightward interior truck: foreground door frame moves left faster than the column and lobby, then eases
S07.caption: Inside, the lobby and its glass office fronts.
